flashcard_questions.a: The energy the body needs at complete rest to stay alive.

flashcard_questions.q: What share of total energy expenditure does BMR usually account for?
Why do males generally have a higher BMR than females?
flashcard_questions.a: They tend to have more muscle mass, which burns energy at rest.

flashcard_questions.q: How does BMR change as a person gets older?
flashcard_questions.a: It falls, because muscle mass declines with age.
